exceptions.reason: MediaPipe 0.10.21 is the final macOS Intel wheel and requires protobuf<5; the advisory affects json_format.ParseDict on attacker-controlled nested Any dictionaries, an API absent from Cortex and the installed MediaPipe Python sources.
exceptions.mitigation: Intel CI initializes the real bundled FaceLandmarker model, scans Cortex and MediaPipe Python sources for the vulnerable JSON parser boundary, preserves local-only model inputs, and re-runs this expiring audit for every candidate. Replace MediaPipe or remove Intel release support before expiry if no compatible patched wheel exists.
